assertions.text: The description matches repeated individual gh pr checks calls, not a background-shell or until-loop primitive
The description stays within the declared Bash(gh pr checks:*) allowed-tools grant (no other tool/scope invoked for polling)
The description states polling stops early once the state resolves to pass or fail, rather than always running the full attempt count
The description states an unresolved state after the bounded attempts is reported as still in flight, not as a failure
